commentary.text: 90+4' Andy Madley is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace will have a goal kick.

90+3' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The linesman makes the right call and Aston Villa will have a corner.

90+2' Brennan Johnson (Crystal Palace) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
90' A substitution has been made. Justin Devenny goes off and Borna Sosa (Crystal Palace) comes on.

90' A pass across the box picks out an unmarked Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) and he tries to place the ball towards the roof of the net, but it goes just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace will have a goal kick.
89' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
86' Aston Villa fail to score from a corner as Dean Henderson (Crystal Palace) leaps to collect the ball.
86' The resulting corner from Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger. The ball goes out of play. Aston Villa are awarded a corner kick.

85' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Aston Villa.

84' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the right post.
84' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) decides to speed play up by quickly sending the free kick into the box.
83' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) receives a yellow card!
82' Substitution. Boubacar Kamara makes his way off the pitch and Lamare Bogarde (Aston Villa) comes on as his replacement.

81' Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa) blows an opportunity as he sends a rebound from just outside of the box narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace will have a goal kick.
80' None of the Crystal Palace players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.

79' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. Crystal Palace have been awarded a corner kick.
78' Brennan Johnson (Crystal Palace) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
78' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. Crystal Palace force their opponents to concede a corner.
75' Crystal Palace seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
73' Unai Emery decides to make a substitution. Lucas Digne will be replaced by Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa).
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Donyell Malen (Aston Villa) comes onto the pitch for John McGinn.

72' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) brilliantly evades multiple challenges and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the roof of the net. It's a weak effort, however, and is easily saved by Dean Henderson.

72' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Aston Villa are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.

69' Crystal Palace slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
67' The whistle blows and Brennan Johnson (Crystal Palace) is booked for an infringement.
67' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) plants a goal-bound header towards the middle of the target after a nice cross inside the box, but one of the defenders manages to deflect it away.
65' Here comes a substitution. Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa) is brought on as a substitute for Jadon Sancho.
63' Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace) slips through the defence and passes the ball in from the edge of the box. Jean-Philippe Mateta picks it up but loses it to one of the defenders.
62' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.

60' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.

60' Brennan Johnson (Crystal Palace) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the roof of the net. His effort, however, is blocked by Marco Bizot, who pulls off a stunning save!
58' Crystal Palace show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted. It's a throw-in for Crystal Palace.
56' Aston Villa are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.

54' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Marco Bizot pulls off an easy save.

51' Dean Henderson makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) inside the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the bottom left corner.
51' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) misses a rebound from the penalty spot. The ball flies just a few inches over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.
50' John McGinn (Aston Villa) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.

47' Brennan Johnson (Crystal Palace) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
46' Aston Villa are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
46' Emiliano Martinez (Aston Villa) is being substituted because of an injury. Unai Emery sends Marco Bizot on the pitch.
46' The second half has just started.
